comment: Which Apple-platform skill a changed file requires. A file requires a skill when its path matches one of the rule's path regexes or its content matches one of the rule's content regexes. Read by swift_skills.py.

rules.covers: async/await, actors, @MainActor, Sendable, tasks, locks, data races
Swift Testing tests: @Test, #expect, suites, parameterized tests
SwiftUI views, state, navigation, layout, animation, gestures, view performance
AppKit, windows, menus, sandboxing, entitlements, distribution, macOS-specific SwiftUI
persistence: SwiftData, Core Data, GRDB, SQLite, CloudKit, Codable, migrations

on_demand.covers: Apple's own documentation for an API, or a Swift compiler diagnostic explained
